out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO SIGNAGE ON ANY OF 4 HAND SINKS LOCATED AT BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. INSTALL SIGNAGE NEXT TO DESIGNATED HAND SINK AT BAR.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: CHEMICAL SANITIZING DISH MACHINE AT BAR - OBSERVED DISPENSING 0PPM CHLORINE.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CFM CALLED FOR IMMEDIATE REPAIR. ALL BARWARE WILL BE WASHED AT MAIN DISH MACHINE. CFM STATE THERE ARE PLANS TO REPLACE MACHINE.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: CHICKEN ALFREDO - SUB STEAK*, SUB SALMON*, BLACKENED CHICKEN CAESAR WRAP - SUB STEAK*, TUNA* BOWL, FRIED RICE CHICKEN BOWL - ADD STEAK*, SALMON*, BREAKFAST BURGER - ADD FRIED EGG*, HUEVOS RANCHEROS - FRIED EGGS*
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. CFM WILL PRINT TABLE TENT TO PLACE ON ALL TABLES SO THAT CUSTOMERS ARE AWARE THAT STEAK, SALMON, FRIED EGG ARE ABLE TO BE COOKED TO ORDER. EHS SPOKE WITH AREA MANAGER WHO WILL WORK ON REPRINTING MENUS. ENSURE “*” IS NEXT TO SPECIFIC PROTEIN , NOT MENU ITEM NAME.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shell eggs stored on shelf above commercial sauce containers in #2.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM moved eggs to bottom of shelf. CRAFTHOUSE (Inspection Date: 06/19/2025) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Observed 0ppm chlorine solution from bar dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. CFM called for service during inspection. Bar dish machine will not be used until repaired. EHS will follow up.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. Observed mold-like substance on baffle of interior of ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. CFM wash, rinsed and sanitized baffle.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed unlabeled spray bottles of degreaser stored near hand sink/dish machine area.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CFM labelled spray bottles.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: #11.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. Thermometer placed in unit.

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. Observed food preparation employees without hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. CFM had food preparation employees don hairnets.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed wall behind hand sink near dish area in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CFM will clean wall.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed chipped tile on floor near kitchen dish machine and ice machine. Observed chipped coving tile in corner wall near #2 (WIC right).
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. CFM will request repair of tiles.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Handwashing
violations.observation: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE CHANGE TASKS WITHOUT WASHING HANDS AND CHANGING GLOVES IN BETWEEN.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager is responsible for monitoring his/her employees for proper hand washing procedures to ensure effective hand washing. CFM EDUCATED EMPLOYEE ON WHEN TO WASH HANDS AND WHEN TO CHANGE GLOVES. EMPLOYEE WASHED HANDS AND CHANGED GLOVES.

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Cleaning and Sanitizing
violations.observation: Employees are not properly sanitizing cleaned multiuse equipment and utensils before they are reused. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE UTILIZED UNSANITIZED THERMOMETER TO TAKE TEMPERATURE OF BEER CHEESE USING MICROWAVE.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train his/her employees to properly sanitize all equipment, utensils, and surfaces after being cleaned using either an approved sanitizer at the adequate concentration or heat sanitization at the proper temperature to destroy pathogenic bacteria. CFM AND EMPLOYEE WASH, RINSED AND SANITIZED THERMOMETER. CRAFTHOUSE (Inspection Date: 12/05/2024) Page 3 of 5

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. OBSERVED NO WRITTEN PROCEDURE FOR THE CLEANUP OF VOMIT OR DIARRHEA EVENT.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CFM PURCHASED BODILY FLUID CLEAN UP KIT DURING INSPECTION. EHS PROVIDED WRITTEN PROCEDURE FOR CLEAN UP OF VOMIT AND DIARRHEA.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE CHANGE TASKS WITHOUT WASHING HANDS AND CHANGING GLOVES.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. CFM EDUCATED EMPLOYEE ON ALL OCCASIONS WHEN WASHING HANDS AND CHANGING GLOVES IS REQUIRED. EMPLOYEE WASHED HANDS AND CHANGED GLOVES.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED 2 HAND SINKS AT BAR WITHOUT HANDWASHING SIGNAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED SIGNAGE TO CFM.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean before Use
violations.observation: The food employee failed to clean the food thermometer probe before use. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE USE FOOD THERMOMETER WITHOUT WASH, RINSING AND SANITIZING THERMOMETER FIRST.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned before using or storing a food thermometer. CFM HAD EMPLOYEE WASH, RINSE AND SANITIZE THERMOMETER AND RETAKE TEMPERATURES.

CFM REPRINTED MENUS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED UNMARKED SPRAY BOTTLES OF SANITIZER AND DEGREASER AT HANDSINK NEAR 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

violations.observation: OBSERVED ROP TUNA THAWING IN WIC WITH PACKAGE STILL INTACT.
violations.corrective_action: CFM HAD EMPLOYEE OPEN PACKAGING OF ROP TUNA. EHS REVIEWED PROPER THAWING PROCEDURE FOR ROP FISH.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED UNLABELED BULK CONTAINER OF SUGAR, OBSERVED UNLABELED SQUIRT BOTTLES OF OIL AND WATER AT FLAT TOP, OBSERVED UNLABELED CONTAINERS OF SPICES AT COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM LABELED CONTAINERS DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not finished to have a smooth, cleanable surface: OBSERVED MILK CRATES BEING USED TO STORE VEGETABLES/FOOD IN WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be finished to have a smooth, easily cleanable surface. CFM TO MOVE ALL FOOD ITEMS STORED IN MILK CRATES TO CONTAINERS THAT ARE SMOOTH AND EASILY CLEANABLE SUCH AS STAINLESS STEEL OR PLASTIC CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED HOT WATER AT BAR 3 COMPARTMENT SINK AT 109F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. CFM TO HAVE ALL DISHWARE WASH, RINSED AND SANITIZED IN MAIN KITCHEN.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: The permit holder has removed the water heater previously approved by the Health Department. The new water heater RINNAI RXP199I (3 UNITS) does not have the capacity to meet the hourly peak hot water demands of the food establishment. The current peak hot water demand is 167 GPH of water at aN 80F rise. OBSERVED RECENTLY INSTALLED TANKLESS GAS WATER HEATERS (3 UNITS). WATER HEATERS WERE INSTALLED WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL FROM HEALTH DEPARTMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Within 30 days, the permit holder shall replace or upgrade the water heater with a unit that meets the following design and capacity requirements: (1) Commercial grade, (2) Minimum of 50 gallon storage tank, (3) Minimum recovery rate of 22.0 GPM AT 80F RISE and (4) Specifications and installation meet National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) Standard 5. The permit holder shall provide the Health Department with the specifications (cut sheet) for the replacement water heater and obtain approval prior to purchase and installation. Please be reminded that equipment replacement or addition is not allowed without prior approval by the Health Department. EHS PERFORMED WATER HEATER CALCULATOR BASED ON RECENTLY INSTALLED TANKLESS WATER HEATER. EHS FOUND INSTALLED EQUIPMENT IS DEFICIENT IN ABILITY TO PROVIDE HOT WATER TO FACILITY. ADDITIONAL 2 UNITS MUST BE INSTALLED, IN PARALLEL, AND AFTER CFM OBTAINS APPROVAL FROM PROPER COUNTY AUTHORITY. CFM TO PROVIDE ADDITIONAL WATER HEATER SPECIFICATIONS TO EHS BEFORE PROCEEDING. EHS WILL FOLLOW-UP ON INSTALLATION WITHIN 30 DAYS.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON MOP SINK FAUCET.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED APPROPED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE PRODUCT INFORMATION TO CFM. CFM PURCHASED APPROVED DEVICE DURING INSPECTION. CRAFTHOUSE (Inspection Date: 12/05/2024) Page 2 of 5
